title: Interactive Coding: for Loop Variations
subtitle: Repeating Fixed Sequences
description: Master loop counters and list iteration across 4 interactive stages!

challenges.title: Stage 1: Zero to Stop
challenges.description: Write <hlt>for i in range(4):</hlt> and print <hlt>i</hlt> to output 0, 1, 2, 3.

challenges.title: Stage 2: Start to Stop Range
challenges.description: Write <hlt>for i in range(1, 5):</hlt> and print <hlt>i</hlt> to output 1, 2, 3, 4.

challenges.title: Stage 3: Stepped Even Numbers
challenges.description: Write <hlt>for i in range(2, 9, 2):</hlt> to output 2, 4, 6, 8.

challenges.title: Stage 4: Direct Collection Traversal
challenges.description: Given <hlt>fruits = ["apple", "banana", "cherry"]</hlt>, iterate with <hlt>for fruit in fruits:</hlt> and print each.
challenges.starter_code:
fruits = ["apple", "banana", "cherry"]
# Stage 4: Traverse list directly
for fruit in fruits:
    print(fruit)
